g.text: OhmBench architecture: from real bugs to detector scores
Solid boxes are files and tools in this repository. Dashed grey boxes are supplied by the user. Red dashed line = blind boundary: evaluator-only files never reach the detector.
then fix.patch; check git tree hash;
no benchmark code in the app
hdc, hdc rport for replay services
(e.g. hiperf stat on the measured window)
stages a blind input per case:
any CLI after "--", e.g. an agent
all cases, strong only, per scene,
groundtruth.json + fix.patch (evaluator only, never staged for the detector)
Case selection: tools/catalog.py list picks the cases (--scene, --tier strong, --data) for run_cases.py, run_hapray.py and score.py
unfixed vs fixed on a phone,

Rejected: pairs that miss their oracle, cases whose backend stopped working (status: excluded with a reason), any benchmark code compiled into the app. Effect below 1.5x = "weak" tier, reported separately.
